name: Scribe
description: [h1]Scribe: Unified Persistent Save Data for YOUR MOD![/h1]<LINE>Scribe is a utility mod that provides a shared, extensible save system for Rain World mods.<LINE>Instead of every mod creating its own save format and handling storage separately, Scribe allows mods to register their own data, save it per-campaign, and access other mods' stored data in a consistent way.<LINE>[hr][/hr]<LINE>[h2]Features[/h2]<LINE>[list]<LINE>[*]Reliable persistent save data<LINE>[*]GUID-based registration to prevent data collisions<LINE>[*]Simple API for loading and saving data<LINE>[*]Support for observing and requesting other mods' save data<LINE>[*]Flexible structured data format<LINE>[*]Automatic serialization and parsing<LINE>[/list]<LINE><LINE>[hr][/hr]<LINE>[h2]For Mod Developers[/h2]<LINE>Scribe provides several ways for mods to interact with persistent data:<LINE><LINE>[b]IRegistry[/b]<LINE>Register your mod's own save data. Your data will be loaded when a campaign starts and saved when the game saves.<LINE><LINE>[b]IObserver[/b]<LINE>Observe another mod's saved data without owning it.<LINE><LINE>[b]RequestLoad()[/b]<LINE>Request another mod's save data when needed, such as from menus or other non-campaign contexts.<LINE><LINE>[hr][/hr]<LINE>[h2]UQLTag Data Format[/h2]<LINE>Scribe uses UQLTag, a compact tree-based data format designed for structured save data.<LINE>It supports:<LINE>[list]<LINE>[*]Labels<LINE>[*]Records<LINE>[*]Groups<LINE>[*]Named Groups<LINE>[*]Nested structures<LINE>[/list]<LINE><LINE>Scribe stores its data in the Rain World save string inside a dedicated data block:<LINE>[code]<LINE>[scribesaves:<uql.scribe:0><uql.terminus:J<JX<help:JX_FALL01:RM>>>]<LINE>[/code]<LINE>Each registered mod receives its own entry inside the block, identified by its GUID. Mods can store arbitrary structured data using the UQLTag format.<LINE><LINE>[hr][/hr]<LINE>[h2]Why Scribe?[/h2]<LINE>Persistent data should not require every mod to reinvent its own save system.<LINE>Scribe provides a shared foundation for mods to safely store information, keep data organized, and cooperate with other mods.<LINE>Made for Rain World mod developers.<LINE>Documentation can be found in Scribe's GitHub Repository: https://github.com/upquilled/uql-scribe <LINE>**Not compatible with Rain Meadow.**
